ma.navigateTo(Object object)

Retain the current page and jumps to a page in the app. However, the tabBar page cannot be displayed. You can use ma.navigateBack to return to the original page. The page stack in a Mini Program has a maximum of 10 layers.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
url String Yes Path (code package path) of the non-tabBar page to be redirected to in the app. The path can be followed by a parameter. Separate a parameter and a path with a question mark (?), separate a parameter key and a parameter value with an equal sign (=), and separate different parameters with ampersands (&), for example, 'path?key=value&key2=value2'.
event Object No Inter-page communication API, which is used to listen for the data sent from an opened page to the current page.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used regardless of whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

ma.navigateTo({
  url: 'example?id=1',
  events: {
    //  Add a listener for a specified event to obtain the data transferred from the opened page to the current page.
    acceptDataFromOpenedPage: function(data) {
      console.log(data)
    },
    someEvent: function(data) {
      console.log(data)
    }
    ...
  },
  success: function(res) {
    // Send data to the opened page through eventChannel.
    res.eventChannel.emit('acceptDataFromOpenerPage', { data: 'example' })
  }
})

//example.js
Page({
  onLoad: function (option) {
    console.log(option.query);
    const eventChannel = this.getOpenerEventChannel();
    eventChannel.emit('acceptDataFromOpenedPage', { data: 'example' });
    eventChannel.emit('someEvent', { data: 'example' });
    //  Listen for the acceptDataFromOpenerPage event to obtain the data sent from the previous page to the current page through eventChannel.
    eventChannel.on('acceptDataFromOpenerPage', function (data) {
      console.log(data);
    });
  }
});
